newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria sells 25,000 tonnes wheat to Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Syria sells 25,000 tonnes wheat to Iraq.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has sold 25,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat to Iraq as part of the oil-for-food deal with the United Nations, a GECPT spokesman said on Monday.
He said the deal, concluded earlier through direct negotiations with Iraqi officials at a price of $200 per tonne, was approved recently by the United Nations.

He said amount would be shipped in September by road through the Syrian-Iraqi border point which was approved by the U.N. on August 1 as a new entry point for humanitarian goods to Iraq under the oil-for-food plan.
